FINAL SQL:
WITH winner_counts AS (
    SELECT winner_id, COUNT(*) AS match_count
    FROM matches
    GROUP BY winner_id
),
top_winner AS (
    SELECT winner_id, match_count
    FROM winner_counts
    ORDER BY match_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
latest_rank AS (
    SELECT r.player_id, r.ranking_points
    FROM rankings r
    JOIN (
        SELECT player_id, MAX(ranking_date) AS max_date
        FROM rankings
        GROUP BY player_id
    ) lr ON r.player_id = lr.player_id AND r.ranking_date = lr.max_date
)
SELECT m.winner_name, lr.ranking_points
FROM matches m
JOIN top_winner tw ON m.winner_id = tw.winner_id
JOIN latest_rank lr ON lr.player_id = tw.winner_id
LIMIT 1;
